overview.description: The Hotchkis & Wiley Global Value Fund ETF (HWGV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI World index. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to own a narrow portfolio of attractively valued companies from global equity markets. The fund uses proprietary fundamental research that combines quality and value factors to pursue long-term capital appreciation. HWGV was launched on Aug 27, 2026 and is issued by Hotchkis & Wiley.

data.title: Hotchkis & Wiley Launches ETF Share Class for Global Value Fund
data.text: LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Hotchkis & Wiley announces launch of an ETF share class for its Global Value Fund. The new ETF is the Hotchkis & Wiley Global Value Fund (HWGV).

news.t: Hotchkis & Wiley Launches ETF Share Class for Global Value Fund

holdings.infoBox: HWGV is an equity ETF with a total of 61 individual holdings. The top holdings are Workday stock at 5.00%, American International Group at 3.42%, Elevance Health at 3.17%, GE HealthCare Technologies at 3.16%, and The Cigna Group at 2.69%.
